crawlability.rationale: The current HTML is an application shell bundled into a desktop executable, not a public web landing page. Explicit robots directives prevent accidental indexing if the shell is served during local or staging validation.

metadata.title: Sandwich Download Manager
metadata.description: Sandwich Download Manager is a Windows desktop app for reliable segmented downloads.

structuredData.rationale: Search-engine structured data belongs on a future public website, which is outside the approved desktop-only v0.1 scope. Adding SoftwareApplication JSON-LD to a non-indexable native webview would be misleading and provide no discovery benefit.

webVitals.rationale: Core Web Vitals are search ranking signals for public web pages. This workstream makes no public page or production deployment claim; desktop runtime responsiveness remains covered by the application performance workstream.

canonicalUrl.rationale: No approved public origin or canonical release URL exists in this request. A fabricated canonical URL would be incorrect.

implementedControls: No-referrer policy to reduce URL leakage
knownRisks: The desktop app has no public, indexable landing page in v0.1, so organic web discovery is intentionally unavailable.
A future public website will require an approved canonical origin, crawl policy, SoftwareApplication structured data, sitemap, social metadata, and field Core Web Vitals monitoring.
